text:
Maine aapke order (ORD-22004) ke liye ₹19,999 ka **refund initiate** kar diya hai. 

Yeh refund aapke original payment method mein 3-5 working days ke andar credit ho jayega. Maine is incident ki ek formal delivery dispute complaint bhi log kar di hai taki courier partner par action liya ja sake.

Aapko aisi pareshani ka samna karna pada, uske liye humein khed hai. Agar aur koi madad chahiye ho toh zaroor bataiyega.
